ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity pixels; approximately 98% black/near-black with less than 2% high-intensity white speckling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominantly uniform black pigmentation across both visible lobes; high-contrast white pixels appear as dispersed, non-contiguous point-clusters (speckles) across the lateral and medial regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch; calculated internal angle approximately 45 degrees at the vertex located at the junction of the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations visible along the trailing edge of the left lobe; right lobe edge appears smoother and exhibits higher pixel-aliasing against the bright background sky.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe trailing edge follows a horizontal, slightly concave curve; right lobe trailing edge exhibits a sharp, steep-angle linear extension toward the upper right frame.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread detection of small, roughly circular high-intensity (white) pixel clusters distributed across the black ventral surface, particularly concentrated on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detected faint vertical linear pixel disruptions near the central insertion point where the fluke meets the peduncle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The distal-most edge of the left lobe exhibits a jagged, irregular termination pattern compared to the more continuous right lobe tip.
